card.title: TOBRUK
card.text: Tobruk is a city in eastern Libya.

Text.SourceString: Tobruk is a city in eastern Libya.

value.value: Our pursuing troops are catching up one by one. Put them to good use.

value.value: We have encircled the town, time to engage the enemy units trying to get out.

value.value: We are in a position to disrupt the enemy defense line, make the most of it.

value.value: Time to smash these stubborn defenses.

value.value: The enemy is trying to consolidate his scattered forces to form a defensive perimeter. Don’t give them the time.

value.value: Our forces are catching up with stragglers from the British 8th Army. We must strike before they get away.
